metaDescription: Shopify store for Azure, a festive womenswear label with menswear: named collections, unstitched or sized options, size charts, reviews and video shopping.
summary: Shopify store for a Pakistani festive womenswear label with a menswear line.
overview: Azure sells festive and formal womenswear, including heavily embroidered three-piece suits, luxury lawn, velvet and smart casual pieces, plus a menswear line called Azureman. We built Azure's Shopify store on the Agile theme for a catalog of close to 180 products.
challenge: Azure's designs are sold both as unstitched fabric and as stitched outfits in sizes XS to XL, often on the same product. The brand runs several named collections, a designer line and menswear side by side, and wants festive shoppers to see reviews and stock status before they decide.
approach: The menu covers New Arrivals, Our Collections (Luxe, Ensembles, Luxury Lawn, Diva, Chic Essentials, Velvet), Azure Vogue by Ahmed Patel, Best Sellers, Sale, Azureman and a blog. A rotating announcement bar carries the current drop, worldwide shipping and the exchange policy. Product pages put star ratings with review counts under the title, then an in-stock indicator, SKU and one size selector that offers Unstitched alongside XS to XL, with a size chart link and fabric and color details.
outcome: A Shopify store where festive shoppers can browse by collection, check reviews and stock, and choose unstitched fabric or a stitched size from the same page, with menswear and the brand's blog in the same storefront.

results.label: Shopping
results.value: By collection, unstitched or sized, reviews

deliverables: Product page with reviews and size chart

process.title: Collections and lines
process.body: Named collections sit under one menu item with short descriptions such as heavy embroidered 3pcs or shirt and trouser, while the designer line and Azureman menswear get their own entries.

process.title: Homepage merchandising
process.body: The homepage moves from a campaign hero through latest drops, ready to wear and best sellers to a Watch. Click. Shop video section and store locations.

process.title: Product pages
process.body: Ratings, price, stock status and SKU come first, followed by a single size row with Unstitched and XS to XL, a size chart link and fabric and color details.

process.title: Content and service
process.body: A blog covers festive and lawn styling, and footer pages handle shipping, the exchange policy, FAQs, store locations and franchise applications.

whyItMatters: Festive wear is a considered purchase, so ratings, stock status and a clear choice between fabric and a stitched size help shoppers commit. Grouping collections by style makes a seasonal range easier to compare.

faqs.q: What platform is the Azure store built on?
faqs.a: It runs on Shopify with the Agile theme, using Shopify collections for each line, product reviews on product pages and a size chart for stitched sizes.

faqs.q: Can Pixel2Tech build a similar Shopify store for my brand?
faqs.a: Yes. We build Shopify stores for fashion labels, including collection menus, unstitched and stitched size options and product pages with reviews. Tell us about your catalog and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
